Serve explicitly configured libsy algorithms

Usage: switchyard-server [OPTIONS] --config <PATH>

Options:
      --config <PATH>
          TOML file defining LLM clients, targets, and algorithm routes
      --host <HOST>
          Host address to bind [default: 127.0.0.1]
  -p, --port <PORT>
          Port to bind [default: 4000]
      --backlog <BACKLOG>
          TCP listen backlog passed to the socket before Axum accepts traffic [default: 65535]
      --shutdown-timeout <SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT>
          Maximum time active requests may drain during shutdown [default: 30s]
      --dry-run
          Validate the algorithm and client configuration without binding a socket
      --routing-log-file <PATH>
          Append durable per-request routing records to this JSONL file
      --pricing-file <PATH>
          This optional TOML or JSON file replaces the entire bundled table of rates in USD per million tokens
      --tls-cert <TLS_CERT>
          TLS certificate path in PEM format
      --tls-key <TLS_KEY>
          TLS private-key path in PEM format
  -h, --help
          Print help
  -V, --version
          Print version
